name: Copy Code
description: A copy button on every code block, with Copied feedback, a language label and optional line numbers. Clean CSS, no highlighting library, no third-party requests.

panels.title: Copy code
panels.description: To add a code block, write it in a text block between two lines of three backticks, with the language after the first: ```bash. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Add a copy button to code blocks
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: language
fields.title: Show the language
fields.description: A small label such as "bash" or "python", taken from the code block's language class.

fields.name: line-numbers
fields.title: Show line numbers
fields.description: Numbers in a gutter on the left. They are never copied.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that are left alone. For example: home, contact
